cases.author: notatallshaw
cases.prompt: Support Python's __replace__ protocol on Specifier and SpecifierSet. Callers can override the operator/version of a single specifier, the specifiers in a set, or prerelease handling. Omitted fields retain their original values, and explicitly resetting prereleases to None restores automatic behavior. A no-op replacement returns the same object. Preserve the original on changes and reject invalid replacements. Document and test the API. Explicitly replacing a set with its equivalent specifiers is also a no-op.

cases.author: CheckPickerUpper
cases.prompt: When the ignore walker is configured to apply Git excludes without requiring a Git repository, linked worktrees should honor the shared repository's info/exclude. Preserve behavior for ordinary directories and when Git excludes are disabled. Add regression coverage.

cases.author: Huang-404-Q
cases.prompt: Make halt_error emit the documented byte-exact stderr output for non-string inputs as well as strings. Preserve its exit status, stdout behavior, and existing null behavior. Add a regression that distinguishes an appended newline.

cases.author: ybai08
cases.complexity: TypeScript Markdown parser, interacting delimiter rules
cases.prompt: Bring emphasis parsing into line with CommonMark delimiter-run flanking and the multiple-of-three rule for runs of asterisks and underscores, including when a run can both open and close. Preserve ordinary emphasis, strong emphasis and intraword behavior. Add focused parser regression examples. Include Unicode delimiter context, including punctuation and combining marks.

cases.author: hiddeco
cases.complexity: Go Git implementation, streamed decoding and file-mode semantics
cases.prompt: Make tree decoding agree with Git on octal file modes. Handle zero padding and modes that span a read buffer, canonicalize regular files using the owner execute bit, and return the malformed-tree error for invalid encodings. Expose Canonical on FileMode for Git's tree mode semantics. FromBytes accepts zero-padded octal values through uint32 and rejects overflow or invalid bytes. Preserve round trips, non-regular types and existing public contracts. Add regression coverage. Tree.Decode should match Git when wide tree-mode fields wrap, independently of the public FromBytes overflow rule.

cases.author: justinthelaw
cases.complexity: GitHub Action, maintenance and immutable workflow pins
cases.prompt: Update the lint tooling to actions/setup-python v7.1.0 (upstream tag commit 6d4fd22b20465ccc0f7354476588e8df7c9ca0e0) and markdownlint-cli2 v0.24.0. Record both changes and any deferred upgrades in the repository's dependency ledger. Preserve supported runtime versions, action behavior and generated distribution.

cases.author: p-r-a-v-i-n
cases.prompt: Fix XOR join promotion in the Django ORM. Positive and negated XOR across nullable relations must retain rows whose truth value depends on an absent related row. Preserve AND, OR and existing INNER JOIN behavior where promotion is unnecessary. Add a query regression.
cases.authorship: author explicitly reports no AI use

cases.author: LuisFigueroaG
cases.prompt: Fix Black's handling of a fmt: skip directive on an opening bracket nested in a longer with, async with, or yield expression. Preserve skipped text, format surrounding code normally, and preserve the AST and idempotence. Add focused formatter fixtures.
cases.native: PYTHONPATH=.:src:/deps/lib python -m pytest -q -o addopts= tests/test_format.py -k fmtskip

cases.author: davidism
cases.prompt: Update Response iterable handling. Recognize Sequence objects, recognize streamed non-sequences even if they have a length, and close the original iterable immediately on conversion. Deprecate mixed nonbytes chunks, Response.stream and automatically_set_content_length while preserving ordinary byte responses. Keep length calculation, warnings, user documentation and tests consistent.

cases.author: knowprasad
cases.prompt: Make Plane.distance compute exact symbolic distances for 3-D points, lines, rays, segments and planes without undecidable intersection checks. Preserve numerical distances, symmetry where defined and results for crossing, parallel and coincident entities. Add regression coverage that substitutes numeric values into symbolic results.

cases.author: paneendrakumar0
cases.prompt: Expose ParameterSet as a documented public type in the pytest namespace for annotations of helpers returning pytest.param(). Keep factories working without warnings, identify the class as belonging to pytest, and warn on unsupported direct construction. Preserve values, marks and ids, and cover the public contract.

cases.author: shadowspawn
cases.prompt: Fix getOptionValueSourceWithGlobals when a parent has an option value with an unknown source. Its undefined source must mask a same-named child source, consistently with the value returned by optsWithGlobals. Preserve recognized global sources, child-only values and nesting. Add regression coverage.

cases.author: vignesh2027
cases.prompt: Fix LabelValues requests for label names containing a slash, or equal to a dot or double dot. Send those as Prometheus Values Escaping names so the server sees one intact path segment. Keep other label names, query parameters and output decoding compatible. Add regression coverage.

cases.author: parneetsingh022
cases.prompt: Reject size constraints whose numeric quantity fits in u64 but whose multiplication by the decimal or binary unit multiplier would overflow. The fd CLI should report an invalid size in both debug and optimized builds, preserve valid values and bounds, and handle signed filter prefixes. Add regression tests.

cases.author: MokiMeow
cases.prompt: Fix formatting the sign on negative floating-point chrono durations. Multiple specifiers in the same format must print the sign once, including seconds, count and compound time formats. Handle negative infinity without losing the sign or repeating it, preserve positive and integer duration output, and add tests.

cases.author: INo-xious
cases.prompt: Allow a complex-number option passed as one argument to parse decimal scientific notation in either component, including signed exponents and pure imaginary numbers. Preserve valid real, parenthesized and hexadecimal representations and reject malformed expressions. Add focused CLI parsing tests.

cases.author: garydgregory
cases.prompt: Add opt-in FIFO fairness to TimedSemaphore using a public builder with period, time unit, limit, optional scheduler and fairness. Preserve old constructors and nonfair defaults, immediate tryAcquire semantics and unlimited mode. Queue blocked acquire calls in arrival order, remove interrupted waiters and wake waiters at shutdown or limit changes. Add tests for public behavior and accounting. Support TimedSemaphore.builder().setPeriod(...).setTimeUnit(...).setLimit(...).setFair(true).get() and setService(...).
cases.build: mkdir -p target/panel-classes && javac -encoding UTF-8 -d target/panel-classes -sourcepath src/main/java src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/concurrent/TimedSemaphore.java

cases.author: ilyas-mallah
cases.prompt: Fix extracting archive data to a nonempty file opened with O_APPEND. Appending entries through bsdtar -xO must preserve the prefix and append all entries without a spurious seek failure. Keep ordinary extraction, pipe output and sparse file handling working. Add a regression.

cases.author: hartwork
cases.prompt: During internal entity expansion accounting, entity-looking text inside CDATA sections, comments or processing instructions is literal. Avoid counting or resolving references inside those regions. Real references outside those regions must still expand, and existing protection against amplification and cycles must remain effective. Add behavior tests.

cases.author: ngan
cases.prompt: Apply config.extend modules to an example group before config.include modules and config.include_context callbacks run. Shared contexts configured for the group should be able to call methods from matching extension modules. Preserve metadata filtering, ordinary includes and inherited group behavior. Add a regression.
